lanes.summary: The diff successfully implements the shapes gate check for the fleet-pinned pv. It correctly handles the 0.65.2 limitation by checking capabilities (the lack of `--gate` and `extract` subcommand) rather than just parsing version strings, and it passes all 10 rows of its self-test perfectly. It fulfills PMAT-3567 without weakening any existing gates.

lanes.summary: The diff introduces scripts/check_fleet_pv_shapes_gate.sh to evaluate the SHACL shapes gate using the fleet-pinned pv binary on the runner rather than a HEAD-built binary. It directly implements asks 2 and 3 of PMAT-3567 by enforcing pin resolution, validating tool capabilities (--gate and extract), parsing JSON verdicts, and allowing UNMEASURED exit 0 on unconverged runners. All 10 self-test scenarios pass and no gates are weakened.

findings.claim: capable() probe rejects binaries lacking --gate or extract subcommands (the 0.65.2 condition) and reports specific capability failure diagnostics
findings.command:
bash -c 'd=$(mktemp -d); printf "0.65.2\n" > "$d/pin"; cat > "$d/pv" << "STUB"
#!/usr/bin/env bash
if [ "$1" = "--version" ]; then echo "pv 0.65.2"; exit 0; fi
echo "no gate flag"
STUB
chmod +x "$d/pv"
FLEET_PV_BIN="$d/pv" FLEET_PV_PIN="$d/pin" FLEET_PV_CONTRACTS="$d" RUNNER_NAME=test-box bash scripts/check_fleet_pv_shapes_gate.sh 2>&1
rc=$?
rm -rf "$d"
exit $rc'
findings.output:

FAIL runner=test-box pin=0.65.2 pv=/tmp/tmp.CtQATQdqho/pv version=0.65.2 -- no --gate on lint; this is the 0.65.2 condition, the gate cannot run here
FAIL
